value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete exact structural classification in a canonical distance-transitive graph family, with a sharp first disconnection at n=6 despite positive rerouting degree in both components, explicit metrics, and an all-pairs prevalence formula. This supplies natural local-routing information absent from the usual diameter and path-count results; it is not an arbitrary small parameter slice.
